Reviewed excerpt of its final answer, with no personal paths or configuration.

Use the held 32-core allocation for the pilot, subject to its actual memory and remaining wall time. Budget reader, writer, worker processes, and internal library threads together:

reader threads + writer threads + workers × threads per worker ≤ 32

First check for existing prepared metadata or indexes. Otherwise, scan the 33 GB table once and stream the gzip XML once. Extract the required fields into a versioned, indexed store keyed by the identifiers downstream builds select.

Use bounded units with per-unit logs and manifests. Record source identity, code version, schema, configuration, counts, and checksums. Write temporary outputs, validate them, then atomically publish them. Reuse only matching, validated outputs.
